protocol.stopping_rule: evaluate the fixed 8-mask bound once on the reused states; an execution failure makes no scientific decision and requires a newly registered fix; a valid result with certificate improvement but no primary physical-action change is recorded as certificate-only and stops; any other valid gate failure closes the bound without tuning; only a full gate pass advances
protocol.prohibited_in_this_stage: arrival generation, trajectory simulation, policy feedback, new seeds, rule variants, confirmation outcomes and paper edits
protocol.support_reference: registered legacy K120 score only; exact means maximum one-frame support and does not define a physical tie or flow oracle
protocol.variant_physical_rank: first_k120_selected_physical_signature_attempt is the first appearance of the variant K120-selected signature on its own search path; it is neither a unique physical optimum nor a flow oracle

next_step: close the binary-price residual-capacity bound without tuning or full trajectories
limitations: The state roster and the rule choice both use consumed development evidence; this is a mechanism screen, not independent confirmation.
The new bound is used as the heap key, so the result concerns the bound-and-expansion composite rather than a sidecar certificate.
The eight binary prices are a fixed Lagrangian relaxation and need not attain the tightest continuous dual bound.
K120 certifies maximum one-frame support only. It neither defines a unique physical tie action nor predicts mean flow or P90.
Legacy visited time is an exposure weight from the source policy and is not the duration of a counterfactual variant trajectory.
